bridge.plan: Two scenes connect a choice with its consequence. Avoid an added moral or assumed reader age.

children.title: Wait
children.brief: The traveler waits for the wind to calm.

children.title: Cross
children.brief: After the wind calms, the traveler crosses.

bridge-1.plan: The traveler chooses to wait at a windy bridge.
bridge-1.draft: The bridge swayed above the stream. The traveler put down a bag and sat beside a stone. There was time to wait.

bridge-2.plan: The wind stops and the traveler crosses.
bridge-2.draft: The wind softened. The ropes grew still. The traveler picked up the bag and crossed, one careful step at a time.
